name: ui-baseline
summary: Client Mods workspace closed: status closed, three pings, then a 2-minute no-capture soak.
notes: Acceptance procedure — not run. Focus-free Dev `mods_ui` + `ping` / socket `logs` / socket `bridge_status` only. Run with `--side client`.

Gate 1 closed baseline: Mods closed, serialize main-thread ops, sample `bridge_status` every 10 s, ping at most every 30 s, watch logs every 15 s, no PrintWindow. After a ping timeout, soak continues with `bridge_status` + `logs` only.

`mods_ui` actions return {ok, action, before, after, detail, elapsedMs}. Status fields: open, site, plugin, page, modsCapture, inputCapture, capture (global alias of inputCapture), panes, observers, width, height, mode. Closed after-state: open=false, curtain=false, modsCapture=false, panes equal the recorded baseline. Do not expect capture/inputCapture false: connected in-game inputCapture is Ui.IsCapturingInput and stays true with Mods closed.
